title: Practice: Kinds of imperative: давай, пусть

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: ___ (let’s, to several people, or one person you call вы) уладим этот вопрос без посредников.
exercises.prompt: Let us settle the matter without a third party.
exercises.why: **Давайте** — «let's», said to several people, or to one person you call вы. **Давай** is for one person you call ты. Either way the verb is the same: a perfective verb takes its мы-form (уладим), an imperfective verb takes the infinitive (Давайте разговаривать!). With a perfective verb the word may be dropped: Пойдём в кино! — and -те added: Пойдёмте! (DLI Grammar Reference Book)

exercises.q: ___ (let’s, to one person you call ты) определим, что правильно, а что нет.
exercises.prompt: Let's make clear which is right and which is wrong.
exercises.why: **Давай** — «let's», said to one person you call ты. **Давайте** is for several people, or for one person you call вы. Either way the verb is the same: a perfective verb takes its мы-form (определим), an imperfective verb takes the infinitive (Давай разговаривать!). With a perfective verb the word may be dropped: Пойдём в кино! — and -те added: Пойдёмте! (DLI Grammar Reference Book)

exercises.q: Доезжайте до подножия холма и ___ (повернуть) налево.
exercises.prompt: Go to the bottom of the hill and turn left.
exercises.why: **повернуть → поверните** — imperative, polite / plural: the singular поверни + -те.

exercises.q: ___ (let’s, to several people, or one person you call вы) побеседуем о масонстве.
exercises.why: **Давайте** — «let's», said to several people, or to one person you call вы. **Давай** is for one person you call ты. Either way the verb is the same: a perfective verb takes its мы-form (побеседуем), an imperfective verb takes the infinitive (Давайте разговаривать!). With a perfective verb the word may be dropped: Пойдём в кино! — and -те added: Пойдёмте! (DLI Grammar Reference Book)

exercises.q: Убей одного – и ты убийца. ___ (убить) миллионы – и ты завоеватель. Убей всех – и ты божество.
exercises.prompt: Kill one man, and you are a murderer. Kill millions of men, and you are a conqueror. Kill them all, and you are a god.
exercises.why: **убить → Убей** — imperative, singular (to «ты»): ending -й (stem ends in a vowel).

exercises.q: ___ (придерживать) свои замечания в рамках предмета нашего обсуждения.
exercises.prompt: Confine your remarks to the matter we are discussing.
exercises.why: **придерживать → Придерживай** — imperative, singular (to «ты»): ending -й (stem ends in a vowel).

exercises.q: ___ (let him, her, them) земля будет тебе пухом, отец!
exercises.why: **Пусть** — «let him, her, them»: пусть + a third-person verb.

exercises.q: Нам нужно сохранить демократию, ___ (let him, her, them) даже с помощью обеднённых ураном бомб.
exercises.prompt: We need to preserve democracy even with depleted uranium bombs.
exercises.why: **пусть** — «let him, her, them»: пусть + a third-person verb.

exercises.q: Эта груша ещё не поспела. ___ (let him, her, them) ещё повисит немного на дереве.
exercises.prompt: This pear isn't ripe yet. It needs to be left on the tree a little bit longer.
exercises.why: **Пусть** — «let him, her, them»: пусть + a third-person verb.
